body:
Blaze Sword Mod 🔥🗡️

Unleash the fury of fire with the ultimate weapon: the Blaze Sword. This unbreakable, fire-resistant sword deals devastating damage and ignites your enemies on every strike. But the real power lies in its special ability — right-click to summon lava and raining anvils on your foes, accompanied by a blazing storm of fire particles that light up the battlefield.

Features:

Massive Damage: 50 base attack damage, enough to obliterate even the toughest mobs.

Fiery Strikes: Set enemies ablaze on every hit.

Epic Right-Click Ability: Spawn lava, raining anvils, and a spectacular fire particle effect.

Unbreakable & Fireproof: Built to last through endless battles.

Step into battle with the Blaze Sword and watch your enemies burn before your might!
